svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Incident response subtitle: Who does what from the first alert to the postmortem, as a cross-functional flowchart kind: flowchart groups: oncall: { type: lane, label: On-call engineer } lead: { type: lane, label: Incident lead } comms: { type: lane, label: Communications } nodes: alert: { shape: terminator, label: Alert fires, in: oncall } ack: { shape: process, label: Acknowledge the page, in: oncall } triage: { shape: process, label: Triage the impact, in: oncall } impact: { shape: decision, label: Customers affected?, in: oncall } fix: { shape: process, label: Fix and monitor, in: oncall } declare: { shape: process, label: Declare an incident, in: lead } mitigate: { shape: process, label: Coordinate mitigation, in: lead } # align puts a step in the same row as the one it names: the lead's check sits beside the # half-hourly updates, and the postmortem is scheduled straight across from the all clear. resolved: { shape: decision, label: Resolved?, in: lead, align: update } review: { shape: process, label: Schedule the postmortem, in: lead, align: allclear } closed: { shape: terminator, label: Incident closed, in: lead } status: { shape: process, label: Post a status page update, in: comms } update: { shape: process, label: Update every 30 minutes, in: comms } allclear: { shape: process, label: Send the all clear, in: comms } edges: - alert -> ack -> triage -> impact - impact -> fix: "No" - impact -> declare: "Yes" - fix -> closed - declare -> mitigate -> resolved - declare -> status -> update - resolved -> mitigate: "No" - resolved -> allclear: "Yes" - update -> allclear - allclear -> review -> closed

svg.title: Incident response
svg.desc: Incident response. 13 components in 3 groups. Connections: Alert fires to Acknowledge the page; Acknowledge the page to Triage the impact; Triage the impact to Customers affected?; Customers affected? to Fix and monitor (No); Customers affected? to Declare an incident (Yes); Fix and monitor to Incident closed; Declare an incident to Coordinate mitigation; Coordinate mitigation to Resolved?; Declare an incident to Post a status page update; Post a status page update to Update every 30 minutes; Resolved? to Coordinate mitigation (No); Resolved? to Send the all clear (Yes); Update every 30 minutes to Send the all clear; Send the all clear to Schedule the postmortem; Schedule the postmortem to Incident closed.

text.tspan: Who does what from the first alert to the postmortem, as a cross-functional flowchart
